provenance: Self-authored signed/system-base word returns. Expected mathematical values established by independent B→R, GETBITS, GETBASE and STRING controls in native-word-controls.json. Typed return metadata must additionally pass the actual firmware test; no proprietary captures bundled.

cases.name: wpositive
cases.source: EXPORT WPOSITIVE() BEGIN Base:=3; Bits:=32; Signed:=0; RETURN #FF:-8h; END;

cases.name: wnegative
cases.source: EXPORT WNEGATIVE() BEGIN Base:=3; Bits:=32; Signed:=0; RETURN #-5:-8h; END;

cases.name: wsysnegative
cases.source: EXPORT WSYSNEGATIVE() BEGIN Base:=3; Bits:=32; Signed:=0; RETURN R→B(-1,-8); END;

cases.name: wsyspositive
cases.source: EXPORT WSYSPOSITIVE() BEGIN Base:=3; Bits:=32; Signed:=0; RETURN R→B(255,8); END;

cases.name: wsigned63
cases.source: EXPORT WSIGNED63() BEGIN Base:=3; Bits:=32; Signed:=0; RETURN R→B(-1,-63); END;

cases.name: wfull64
cases.source: EXPORT WFULL64() BEGIN Base:=3; Bits:=32; Signed:=0; RETURN #FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF:64h; END;

cases.name: wsysdefault
cases.source: EXPORT WSYSDEFAULT() BEGIN Base:=3; Bits:=32; Signed:=0; RETURN R→B(42); END;

cases.name: wbasegetter
cases.source: EXPORT WBASEGETTER() BEGIN Base:=3; Bits:=32; Signed:=0; Bits:=8; Signed:=1; RETURN GETBASE(#FFh); END;
